_about: ARES verified facts for the web app (NASA Space Apps 2026). Every value has a source and a status. ✅ verified against primary source; ⚠️ supported, show with caveat; ❌ do not show as fact. Compiled 15 Nov 2026.

site.name: Mount Sharp boxwork, Gale crater (GALE-BX)

aoi.convention: planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, Mars sphere R = 3396190 m
aoi.source: Team AOI from Curiosity drive positions (MSL Analyst's Notebook); 100 % on valid DTM pixels (checked 14 Nov 2026)

site.drill_stops_status: ✅ positions = rover positions from MSL Analyst's Notebook 'Drive locs'; elevations from HiRISE DTM DTEEC_009149 (MOLA areoid)

campaign_sols.source: GSA 2025 abstract Siebach et al. (entry); MSL mission blog (drilling, exit 'Bye-Bye Boxwork', planning 27 Mar 2026)

elevation_context.meaning: approx. groundwater level inferred for boxwork formation, NOT a surface elevation

slope.method: block-average to ~5.06 m, Horn (1981) slope, degrees
slope.why_5m: 1 m slope noise from DTM height error alone: mean ~6 deg, p95 ~12 deg (sigma_z 0.2 m, Monte Carlo); 5 m: ~0.25-1.2 deg. Thresholds were derived on 5 m lunar data.

15.source: Peña-Asensio et al. 2024, Acta Astronautica 214:324-342, doi:10.1016/j.actaastro.2023.10.010

20.source: NASA EVA-EXP-0075 (NTRS 20200001071), slide 6: lunar suit design case

10.status: ❌ display break only, never call it a limit

slope.label: Slope from HiRISE DTM (MRO), ~5 m baseline. Thresholds are lunar analogs, not Mars suit limits.

optical.label: HiRISE orthoimage PSP_009149_1750 (MRO), same stereo pair as the DTM, acquired 9 Jul 2008.
optical.status: ✅ listing verified; open with gdalinfo to confirm

thermal.product: USGS THEMIS quantitative thermal inertia mosaic, tile 30S120E, 100 m/px (Fergason et al. 2006 method)
thermal.url_status: ⚠️ inferred from the verified 30S060E name; check with curl -I

published_value.source: Fraeman et al. 2016, JGR Planets 121(9):1713-1736, doi:10.1002/2016JE005095, Table 2

thermal.label: Thermal inertia (NOT surface temperature), THEMIS/Mars Odyssey, 100 m/px, ~20 % absolute accuracy. Context only, coarser than the route grid.
thermal.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU; USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2006

geology.fact: No public vector map of the boxwork boundary exists.
geology.label: Boxwork boundary: team interpretation from HiRISE ortho and rover contact crossings (sols 4534, ~4832-4848). Not an official geologic map.

science_notes.text: Ridges 1-2 m tall; X-ray analysis found clay in the ridge sample and carbonate in the hollow sample.
Nevado Sajama (ridge) and Valle de la Luna (hollow) drill sites ~10 m apart, ~2 m height difference.

radiation.source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343, doi:10.1126/science.1244797, Table 1 (GCR only, MSL/RAD 2012-13, ~300 sols, solar maximum)
radiation.label: Radiation dose (published mean, not live): 0.64 ± 0.12 mSv/day, GCR only, MSL/RAD 2012-13 at solar maximum. 2026 values are likely higher.

space_weather.verified: 15 Nov 2026: FLR and CME return JSON, no API key
space_weather.label: Space weather advisory (live, NASA CCMC DONKI). Solar events observed from Earth orbit. Not a radiation dose at Mars.
space_weather.mars_arrival_label: CME arrival at Mars (model forecast, NASA CCMC WSA-ENLIL). Model, not a measurement or a radiation dose.
space_weather.physics_note: Hassler 2014 Fig. 1: ICMEs caused Forbush decreases (lower GCR dose); one SEP on sol 242 raised it. A CME arrival means 'conditions change', not 'more dangerous'.
space_weather.credit: NASA CCMC DONKI; instruments SOHO LASCO (ESA/NASA), STEREO-A (NASA), GOES CCOR-1 (NOAA), SDO (NASA)

weather.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2, climatology average solar scenario, LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES (www-mars.lmd.jussieu.fr/mcd_python/)

we_wind_ms.note: W-E component only; total speed needs S-N component

weather.plausibility: consistent with published REMS ranges (ground max 250-290 K, min 170-210 K; pressure diurnal ±50 Pa)
weather.label: Model climatology for today's season (Mars Climate Database v6.2). Not a forecast, not a measurement.

mars_date.method: Allison & McEwen 2000 (Mars24), reproduces paper example to 5e-5 deg
mars_date.label: Mars date (computed): Ls, MY

do_not_claim: real-time weather or radiation dose on Mars
slope thresholds as Mars-validated suit limits
Curiosity is at the boxwork now (it left ~sol 4846-4848, March 2026)
